'''Maximum Security Pod J-P1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] maintenance facility in the [[Prison Tech Station]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Cipher Nine]] attacked the facility to disable its equipment and systems, and also overload its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. Doing so distracted the [[SCORPIO]] security system of [[Megasecurity Ward 23]], preventing it from purging a recently-uploaded computer virus from the prison's warden droids.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maximum Security Pod J-P1 is a class-restricted area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Imperial Agent class mission "Legerdemain" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
